name: Good Way Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Globally, Good Way Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, production, and distribution of USB and personal computer peripheral devices. Its extensive product portfolio features various docking stations, such as cutting-edge USB4, Thunderbolt 3 and 4 models, versatile USB-C docks (supporting single and multi-display setups), universal solutions, and intelligent smart docks. Additionally, the company provides a range of multi-port hubs for both USB and USB-C connections, alongside adapters for dual video, USB video, Ethernet, and USB cables. Furthermore, its offerings encompass video converters, wireless docking solutions, and dongles. Beyond these, Good Way Technology markets peripherals for HDMI/DisplayPort and 3D televisions, DLNA-enabled wireless audio devices, Bluetooth wireless receivers, and a selection of other wireless technologies. Comprehensive sales and technical support services complement its product lineup. Established in 1983, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
